timing: Numerical design fixed during Task09 after Task08 outcomes; family equations alone were previously exposed.
claim: Portability of the shared held-input feasibility/obstruction criterion under a six-state actuator-lag model; not unchanged spacecraft-code transfer or a novel general safety theorem.

dynamics.units: m, s, m/s, m/s^2; u is commanded acceleration
dynamics.disturbance_semantics: Constant unknown acceleration on the complete episode; independently bounded components. No arbitrary disturbance derivative claim.

physical_property.description: Triangular center-position workspace; fixed cart footprint is already absorbed into these center constraints. A synthetic research enclosure, not a certified robot workspace.

measurement: Timestamped aliased cell code. A packet identifies a declared union of six-dimensional boxes. Every compatible state produces the same code; no true hypothesis is supplied to a policy. Actuator state bounds are included. Covariance is not used as a deterministic bound.
sampling: Fixed deterministic seed salts, no qualification exclusion; all generated cases retained. Descriptive stratified counts, no operational frequencies or superiority p-values.

distribution.face_selection: cyclic faces from case index; pair uses consecutive faces; triple all three

candidate: Residual-checked necessary inequalities at queue endpoints and half/full held times; minimum-norm feasible proposal; checked continuous prefix through endpoint envelopes plus curvature margins. No HCW coefficients reused.
predictive_comparator: Re-derived robust one-hold predictive feasibility comparator with 64 subdivisions and exact input norm; same finite-prefix obligation. This is a prefix specialization, NOT a claimed port of the original terminal-set/full-recovery theorem.
barrier_comparator: Re-derived relative-degree-three exponential barrier with lambda=2/hold. Check h,psi1,psi2 at application; require psi3 over the entire held interval using derivative margins. No infinite-horizon recursive-feasibility claim.
singletons_and_pairs: Evaluate lag-aware criterion on all proper nonempty singleton/pair subsets after the full-set methods. These are descriptive mechanistic checks, not new independent cases.

assumption_stress.change: reference plant tau is four times declared tau; commands and predictions stay fixed
assumption_stress.scope: Deliberate assumption violation, excluded from the 128-case in-assumption endpoint; no subsequent retuning.

recovery: No terminal invariant set, full recovery, hold acquisition, or closed-loop mission utility is credited. Prefix witness feasibility and common-policy impossibility over the held interval remain distinct.

execution.resume: No automatic second invocation. Preserve all completed and started attempts. An interrupted campaign remains incomplete until a separately reviewed continuation can account for unfinished work without rerunning started cases.

reproduction: Fresh standard-library-only environment and isolated source export of the independent Taylor/Bernstein referee. Replay exact recorded commands and dual evidence, not policy timing or protected trials. No laboratory independence claim.
